name: Mont Manengouba
description: A mountain famous for its verdant caldera, home to the magnificent twin crater lakes (male and female).
bonASavoir: The actual cost: There is no official state barrier, but the caldera is managed by local communities (the Bororo herders and surrounding villages). A community contribution of approximately 2,000 to 5,000 FCFA is requested at the entrance to the site.The reality on the ground: If you book a trek with an overnight bivouac at the twin lakes through a local agency (including guide, camp logistics, and meals), prices start at around 45,000 FCFA per person.
